channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Are Sneakers Dead?
item.description: After looking at the state & fate of footwear, this volume of the Highsnobiety Shopper newsletter simply had to ask: Are sneakers… dead?

item.title: Nike’s Craziest Ballet Sneaker Is Shox-ingly Good
item.description: Naked's Nike Shox Z Calistra collaboration lands a ballet-inspired spin on the techy-dressy sneaker.

item.title: Nike’s Sneaker-Coded Air Max Sandal Is Too Cool for Summer School
item.description: Nike's Air Max Halo sandal appears in a "Metallic Cool Grey" colorway, essentially slipping into a classic Swoosh outfit for its debut.

item.title: An Italian Shoemaker & an Afro-Atlantic Architect Created the Ultimate Slipper (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Architect Giles Tettey Nartey's first shoe is a Ghanaian slipper made by Italian avant shoemaker Demon. We spoke with Tettey Nartey about how it came to be.

item.title: Nike’s Most Tasteful Cortez Sneaker Is Lowkey Adorbz
item.description: Serena Williams Design Crew puts a crafty spin on the iconic Nike Cortez sneaker for its latest release.

item.title: adidas’ Coziest Clogs Are a Birkenstock-Minded Farm Flex
item.description: The adidas Adimule clog is back & furrier than ever, thanks to a cow-print fur makeover.

item.title: Bob Marley Is Behind This Seriously Stylish adidas Samba
item.description: The adidas Samba sneaker gets a bold makeover celebrating Bob Marley. Here's everything on the stylish take.

item.title: Birkenstock Put the Boston Clog In Sport Mode
item.description: The Birkenstock Boston Crosstown is the closest thing to a Boston trail clog. But still, wear these backless shoes in the mountains at your own risk.

item.title: Marika Thunder Makes Vans Her Next Canvas
item.description: Marika Thunder was painting on her dad’s white Vans before she could spell “authentic.” Now she is defining the word on her own terms.

item.title: adidas’ Crazy Handball Sneaker-Loafer Is Too Wild for the Office
item.description: adidas' Handball Spezial Loafer is a mix between a simple sneaker & a classic loafer — built for the literal jungle.
